name: Table
summary: A data grid — results, leaderboard, participant/admin list — rendered through the shared DataTable.
lead: Too complex to rebuild as a web component, so Table stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both rendered through the shared DataTable and themed once by components.Table. Two implementations, one DS V3 look, policed by visual regression. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

props.name: columns
props.desc: dataIndex / key / title / sorter / filter / fixed / width

props.name: freezable
props.desc: right-click header to freeze one column

whenToUse.when: any rows×columns grid — results, leaderboard, admin list
a bare antd Table restyled per call site is the drift this replaces

opinion.note: White header (not antd grey #fafafa), single-arrow sort (not dual caret), Phosphor icons, tokenised colour. The look is theme-driven; call sites pass data + columns only.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme + the same DataTable wrapper; residual drift is caught by visual regression.
